evidence_items.explanation: The filing attributes the training-use decision to escalation to Zuckerberg, supporting Marcus's tentative inference of personal approval. The same paragraph reports material contrary evidence: Zuckerberg testified that he lacked knowledge of LibGen or involvement in its use.
The judgment limits any implication that the training use was established legal theft. It concerns the named plaintiffs and does not determine whether Zuckerberg approved the historical use.
